## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:pane` passes, if this changes `plugins/claude-code` or `packages/showboard/src/text`
- [ ] A test is added or updated, if this changes what Showboard does
- [ ] The README or `docs/reference.md` is updated, if this changes something people see or type
- [ ] I have read the whole diff (AI-assisted changes are welcome)
